d:
China and the Philippines went head-to-head in a PHYSICAL and thrilling matchup at the FIBA U18 Asian Championship 2018!
The Philippines built a big lead, but China refused to back down, fighting their way back into the game and making things tense in the fourth quarter. A huge defensive play by AJ Edu helped the Philippines hold on for a 73-63 win!
Watch the BEST moments from this intense clash between two of Asia's basketball powerhouses!
